userAcceptance.note: User praised digital Resolve, requested reversed Place, then chose the pair as the default for all towers. This records acceptance of the effect direction; final revision-specific author evidence is separate from explicit user approval of r12.

limitations: Digital coverage/cubes require tools/asset-presentation/digital-resolve.js; a plain GLB viewer plays only the eye/pose tracks. Gameplay presentation must integrate the shared module and retain an exit visual through Resolve.
The scene fragment budget limits geometry but is not a measured target-device FPS guarantee. Prepare surface samples during loading.
